user.title: Connect to Qixu voice service
user.description: Home Assistant dials out to this endpoint and offers the entities exposed to voice assistants.

data_description.endpoint: Issued by the Qixu console, e.g. wss://voice.example.com/mcp
data_description.token: Sent with the connection so the Qixu service can identify this Home Assistant
data_description.home_id: Distinguishes sites on the same endpoint, e.g. office-5f
data_description.confirm_keywords: Comma separated. Matching tool calls return a confirm ID and run only after confirmation

error.invalid_endpoint: Endpoint must start with ws:// or wss://
error.llm_api_required: Select at least one control API

abort.already_configured: This endpoint and site ID are already configured
